text:
ANTIFRAUD::guid
Description
This iRules command returns GUID value, only in context of ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN event.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
guid
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
{
log
local0.
"Infected username with GUID [ANTIFRAUD::guid] tried to log in."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
Introduced: BIGIP-12.0.0
